verdict.rationale: AI assistance is a fair axis for terminal emulators, so this story applies to kitty. However, the evidence pack documents no built-in AI features, no toggle to enable or disable them, and no controls over what session data leaves the machine. The remote-control CLI that external agents can drive is a developer building block, not a first-party AI feature with data-egress controls, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use or fully disable AI features with clear control over what session data leaves my machine, without a forced login
